name: HospitalityEnglish — Accounts & Auth MVP — WorkEnglish-compatible

reasons: Supports Google and Apple social sign-in
Supports anonymous users and account linking
Keeps identity management separate from FastAPI/Mongo learning data
Fits future multi-vertical WorkEnglish account model
Avoids building password/security infrastructure in the MVP

workenglish_model.principle: One user account can own one or more profession learning profiles.

guests_existing_collection_extension.description: Keep the existing guests collection to avoid a risky pre-launch migration. Treat each guest document conceptually as a profession learning profile.
guests_existing_collection_extension.future_debt_note: After launch, guests can be renamed/migrated to learning_profiles without changing the user/auth model.

account_events.purpose: Audit account linking, sign-in, logout and deletion without storing provider tokens.

bootstrap: If no Firebase user exists, sign in anonymously.
Send Firebase ID token + current guest_id to backend bootstrap.
Backend verifies token and maps anonymous firebase_uid to current guest profile.
first_account_creation: Link Google or Apple credential to the CURRENT anonymous Firebase user whenever possible.
Firebase UID remains stable after successful linking.
Backend creates/updates a users document and attaches the current hospitality guest profile.
Do not copy or rewrite progress collections; keep the same guest_id so all existing progress remains intact.
existing_account_sign_in: If provider credential already belongs to another Firebase user, sign in to that existing Firebase account.
Backend resolves its canonical hospitality guest profile.
Do not silently overwrite the target account with the temporary guest profile.

For V1, if the temporary guest has meaningful activity, retain it as an unmerged local profile and show a non-blocking message that current account progress has been loaded. A generic merge service may be added later if analytics show this case matters.
guest_to_account_strategy.cross_device: On another device, provider sign-in resolves firebase_uid -> users -> profile_ids_by_profession['hospitality'] -> canonical guest_id.

auth_flow.guest: App works without a visible account requirement.
auth_flow.sign_up_google: Link current anonymous Firebase user to Google, preserve guest_id.
auth_flow.sign_up_apple: Show explicit consent that current HospitalityEnglish progress will be linked to the Apple account, then link current anonymous Firebase user.
auth_flow.sign_in_existing: Resolve canonical hospitality profile for the authenticated Firebase UID.
auth_flow.logout: Sign out authenticated Firebase user, clear authenticated profile from local app state, start a new anonymous Firebase session and fresh guest profile so the previous user's data is not visible.
auth_flow.session_validation: Backend verifies Firebase ID token on protected account endpoints.

backend_endpoints.auth: Firebase Bearer token + recent reauthentication on client

account_entry_points: Optional save-progress card after meaningful guest progress
frontend.benefit_copy: Save your progress and continue on another device.
frontend.apple_link_consent: Your current HospitalityEnglish progress will be linked to your Apple account and available across devices.

apple.implementation_note: Use Firebase's Apple reauthentication/revokeAccessToken flow when Apple auth is enabled.

deletion.provider_account: Delete Firebase Authentication user only after associated HospitalityEnglish data deletion succeeds or is idempotently confirmed.

progress_preservation.principle: First guest -> account conversion must preserve 100% of existing progress without bulk migration.
progress_preservation.method: Attach existing guest profile to user instead of creating a new profile.
progress_preservation.future_profession_support: One user may map to a separate canonical profile_id per profession.

tests: Guest can still use app with no account.
Existing guest progress remains intact after Google account linking.
Existing guest progress remains intact after Apple account linking.
Google-linked account resolves same canonical guest_id after refresh.
Apple-linked account resolves same canonical guest_id after refresh.
Cross-device sign-in resolves same hospitality guest profile.
Logout never exposes previous authenticated profile.
New anonymous session after logout gets fresh guest profile.
Backend rejects invalid/expired Firebase ID token.
Backend ignores client-supplied firebase_uid and derives identity from verified token.
user.professions includes hospitality.
user.active_profession is hospitality in V1.
guest.profession_id is hospitality.
50 situations remain 25/25.
Assessment intact.
Emergency Phrases intact.
Tonight's Shift intact.
